name: Alexis Mac Allister

career_stints.note: All competitions. Won the 2016/17 Argentine Primera B Nacional (second division) in his debut season.
Loan spell; won the 2019/20 Primera Division with Boca.

All competitions across four seasons (the Boca loan ran concurrently with his Brighton contract). Broke out under Graham Potter/Roberto De Zerbi as an attacking central midfielder before a ~£35m move to Liverpool, July 2023. The CM/AM share is this profile's estimate based on his known role evolution there, not a directly sourced split.

All competitions combined across his first two Liverpool seasons (46 apps/7g/7a in 2023/24, including a Carabao Cup win; 35 apps/5g/5a in 2024/25). Played predominantly as a progressive central/attacking midfielder in this period.

All competitions, 2,664 minutes, average match rating 6.85. Reported to have played in a deeper, more controlling role this season -- a meaningful shift from his earlier box-to-box/attacking profile at Brighton and in his first two Liverpool seasons. The DM/CM share is this profile's estimate reflecting that reported shift, not a directly sourced split.

notes: The 2025/26 'deeper, more controlling role' description (matchbingo.co.uk, transfermarkt) is a qualitative characterization, not a sourced positional-minutes split -- used to justify shifting the primary position estimate from CM (his Brighton/early-Liverpool profile) to DM, but the CM/AM/DM share_of_minutes figures throughout this profile are this profile's own estimates, flagged as such rather than presented as sourced data.
World Cup winner (2022) and Copa America winner (2024) with Argentina -- included for context, not used as a quantitative input.
